steps.en: Driver notices about to reach the second letter are sent for an ID holder check
steps.id: Notice driver yang akan ke surat kedua dikirim untuk pengecekan data pemegang ID

steps.en: The driver's latest ID holder details are received and saved
steps.id: Data terbaru driver pemegang ID diterima dan disimpan
steps.why_en: The file exchange with the government agency cannot be confirmed from the code.
steps.why_id: Pertukaran file dengan instansi pemerintah tidak bisa dipastikan dari code.

steps.en: FIN holder and company drivers are checked and updated through the data hub
steps.id: Driver pemegang FIN dan company dicek dan diperbarui lewat data hub
steps.why_en: This check is switched off in production settings; passport holders are never checked.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ini dimatikan di pengaturan produksi; pemegang paspor tidak pernah dicek.

steps.en: After the check, the driver notice can get the second letter
steps.id: Setelah pengecekan, notice driver bisa dikirim surat kedua
steps.why_en: Nothing makes the second letter wait for the check result; only the timing of the schedules orders them.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang membuat surat kedua menunggu hasil pengecekan; hanya urutan jadwal.
